title: Feeding Tips for the First Month
content: Breastfeeding on demand helps establish a healthy milk supply. Try feeding every 2-3 hours.

title: How to Build a Sleep Routine
content: Create a calm bedtime ritual with a bath, soft lights, and a quiet story to help baby sleep better.

title: Recognizing Baby Fever
content: A temperature above 38°C is a fever. Keep baby hydrated and contact a pediatrician if it persists.

title: Milestones at 6 Months
content: At 6 months, many babies sit with support, babble, and begin to explore solid foods.
